title: Outlook: connection, bounded reads and exact independently reviewed actions
goal: Distinguish Outlook setup and bounded reads from exact independent review and separate one-attempt requester execution, preserving unknown outcomes without resending.
prerequisites: Internal source-only draft, not customer-approved content. Current installed-version support, service activation and actual connection health must be verified separately.
Current verified desktop workspace identity, membership, accepted Outlook provider access and consenting mailbox ownership; browser setup authority does not become desktop action authority.
Read consent requests openid, offline_access, User.Read, Mail.ReadBasic, Calendars.Read. Action consent additionally requests Mail.Send and Calendars.ReadWrite.
permissions: connections:manage maps to owner/admin; agent:approve maps to owner/admin/security_reviewer in inspected source. Current server checks, mailbox ownership and separate action consent are decisive; role labels alone grant no execution.

Calendars.Read can authorize broader calendar data than the bounded selected fields. Fetching no bodies/attachments is not a Microsoft permission guarantee; exact action content and event readback can include bodies.
Read route requires desktop session/workspace:read/membership/provider access and excludes API-key authority. Runtime reads bind workspace, connection revision, account and consenting user.
Required review is a genuine personal decision by a different eligible human; this article, checkbox and fixture do not make that decision.

steps.instruction: Open Apps & skills, select All or Apps, and search Outlook. Open Outlook expands the embedded card; Close Outlook collapses it. Settings → Integrations mounts the same card.
steps.expectedState: Opening checks status; closing neither disconnects nor revokes consent.

steps.instruction: Use Connect or Manage only with the current verified workspace credential and connections:manage. Browser account setup must match the current Axiom user/workspace.
steps.expectedState: Setup navigation is not Microsoft consent or desktop action authority. Awaiting service activation disables Connect.

steps.instruction: On browser setup, Connect Outlook begins read consent. Optional action access → Review action permissions is separate and requires an active verified connection owned by the same user/mailbox. After setup return and Refresh status.
steps.expectedState: Scopes/profile/fixed mailbox-calendar reads and checked-connection persistence must succeed; Microsoft sign-in or a callback notice alone does not verify current desktop reads.

steps.instruction: Inspect the account line and status: Status not loaded, Awaiting service activation, Not connected, Available to the mailbox owner, Reconnect required, Needs attention or Connected.
steps.expectedState: Read access only differs from Action consent recorded; exact approval still required. Connected is stored status, not evidence of a just-completed provider read.

steps.instruction: When Connected and authorized, Read mailbox context reads the current instant through seven days later. Inspect observed time, inbox subject/sender, event subject/start and Cancelled indicators.
steps.expectedState: Up to ten recent inbox metadata records and twenty calendar records, no pagination. No editable range in this card; server maximum is31days. Empty/truncated lists describe only this bounded view.

steps.instruction: Use Clear local view to clear displayed mailbox context; use Refresh status after connection/read errors and confirm current user/workspace/consenting owner.
steps.expectedState: No provider deletion, consent revocation, stored-credential erasure or action cancellation. This bounded read selects no bodies/attachments and does not upload context to AI.

steps.instruction: Open saved actions and Reload saved actions to inspect up to twenty recent reviews. An Execution is not activated notice preserves saved reviews; it is not permission to execute.
steps.expectedState: Panel availability after status differs from service activation. Both existing connection/action flags and current server authority remain decisive; their current values are unverified.

steps.instruction: When canRequest permits, Prepare an email or event draft: choose Send one email or Create one calendar event, enter recipients/required attendees, subject and exact plain-text content. Events also require valid local Start/End. Save exact action for review.
steps.expectedState: A fresh intent ID stores an exact mailbox/connection-bound proposal with15minute expiry; no Microsoft folder draft or provider submission. Saved review shows UTC event times. No form Cancel, edit-saved-plan or delete-review control.

steps.instruction: Read kind/state, attempt count out of one, mailbox, recipients/attendees, subject, exact content, event UTC times, digest and expiry. Personally check I reviewed this exact mailbox, recipients, content and time only after inspecting them.
steps.expectedState: Checkbox is local digest review, not approval; request/reload clears it. Approval and receipt appear only when recorded.

steps.instruction: A different eligible authorized human uses Approve exact action when server canApprove permits: agent:approve, requested state and unexpired intent.
steps.expectedState: Records exact independent approval; requester cannot self-approve. No provider submission. Current server capability and exact intent are rechecked.

steps.instruction: Only the original requester/executor uses Execute once when canExecute permits and current authority, exact review, connection, membership/provider access, sessions, freshness and outbound guards pass.
steps.expectedState: A single attempt is allowed; visibility is not proof of execution permission. Microsoft mail acceptance does not verify delivery; event confirmation requires matching provider readback.

steps.instruction: Cancel is available to the requester for requested/approved state. Resolve expired attempt is available to the executor for dispatching state; Reload saved actions reconciles uncertain mutations first.
steps.expectedState: Cancel is pre-dispatch only, not mail recall/event removal. Before lease expiry resolve returns the existing record; after expiry records unknown, without resend, delivery verification or rollback.

expectedOutcome: Identify the current stored status and exact review/attempt record without confusing setup, consent, local clearing, approval, mail acceptance or uncertainty with verified provider completion.
limitations: Customer eligible: false. Publication approved: false. Editorial accepted: false. Media accepted: false. Native accepted: false. Release accepted: false. Shipped accepted: false. Review fields remain null and media is empty; no authentic screenshot, video, walkthrough or current live acceptance is claimed.

All proposed. screen/control IDs are authoring-only candidates, not installed help bindings or runtime identifiers. No ingestion, retrieval engine, customer publication, new feature, permission or activation is created.

This finite article condenses the preserved Outlook guide. Historical guide/manifest/source report retain ad8efae1 provenance; this article binds current7193de93 hashes without rewriting that history.27 exact ranged bindings cover25 unique code files; the unchanged manifest preserves every range.
No attachments, CC/BCC, arbitrary send-as, bulk actions or retry button in this panel. Read view is bounded and not an entire mailbox/calendar.

Current flags/access, native/UI usability/accessibility, editorial/media/release/customer acceptance remain unverified. Source identity validation proves hashes, not semantic accuracy, runtime behavior, provider success or shipped availability.
Evaluation fixture is proposed-not-executed prose only; no retrieval/model evaluation has run. Internal schema/hash validation does not confer editorial or customer approval.
recovery: For unknown mail/event outcome, inspect Outlook and Reload saved actions on the original review. This attempt is not resent; do not invent a new action solely to bypass uncertainty.

Unconfirmed mutating requests lock further mutations. Reconcile the original record first; pending draft save must be found by its original intent ID. If missing, preserve warning/uncertainty rather than creating replacement.
Do not replay an uncertain OAuth callback/exchange/save. Inspect current status before another setup.
Refresh status after read failure; confirm current user/workspace, consenting owner and setup/access. Blank lists/stale Connected are not verified current access.
Workspace changes clear local form/review data and abort client requests; abort/close is not provider cancellation or an outcome receipt. Cancel cannot recall submitted mail or remove an event.
